summary: Solid D1.3 lesson with strong one-to-one trap walkthrough and well-aligned worksheet. Blocked on instructional_balance: lesson_specific_materials REQUIRES 'Detective Dot and Tally puppets' — per the rubric puppets must be optional, since most Canadian G1 classrooms do not have them on hand. Reframe the puppets as optional (gesture/stuffed-animal fallback) to clear the gate.

category_feedback.specific_evidence: lesson_specific_materials lists 'Detective Dot and Tally puppets' as a required item with no optional fallback. The rubric explicitly flags lessons that REQUIRE puppets as Level 2 because most teachers do not have them.
category_feedback.required_fix: Reword the puppet entry to be explicitly optional with a no-prep fallback, e.g., 'OPTIONAL: Detective Dot and Tally puppets — if you have them. If not, point to a stuffed animal, use a sketch on chart paper, or simply gesture/voice the characters.' Mirror this change in minds_on/teacher_script so the lesson can run with voice and body alone.
